from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u060/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    line = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 2 for v in row)), None)
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value != 4:
                if value == 2:
                    out[r][c] = 2
                continue
            nr = min(r + 1, h - 1)
            out[nr][c] = 4
            if line is not None and r == line - 2:
                for d in range(1, nr + 1):
                    rr = nr - d
                    for cc in (c - d, c + d):
                        if 0 <= cc < w:
                            out[rr][cc] = 4
    return out
'''
path=program_dir/'task-13cbbff4.py'
path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(path),'exec'),globals())
print(path)
